tldr: On every finite full-support assignment law, laminar conditioning and saturated assignment-feature classes make universal conditional product validity of independently tie-randomized CRT p-values equivalent to a local feature-factorization predicate. Within this note's universal lift of Zhang and Zhao's tuple-wise premise, \(\mathsf{ZZ}\) and \(\mathsf L\) coincide for \(K\leq2\), and strict separation first becomes possible at \(K=3\). The causal conclusion is a separate transfer for frozen assignment maps in the audited classes that satisfy the explicit blockwise recovery contract. Rationality is needed only for rational-threshold countercertificates and the exact polynomial-time audit of explicitly encoded tables. The local sufficiency mechanism itself is not claimed as new.
gap: Zhang and Zhao prove a sufficient theorem for each selected statistic tuple under common-refinement independence, but the checked literature does not characterize when an entire saturated assignment-feature class is universally safe, whether binary statistics detect every failure, how to audit the property exactly, or how to state the causal null-imputation transfer as an independently checkable observation-recovery relation.
